title: Behavioral economics and microeconomic evidence
review_type: Author review and independent exact computation, submitted for root acceptance

numerical: Reference model: four parameter cases, thresholds from direct bundle utility, strict-side/tie checks, fixed-bundle reversals and both lottery solutions
Time and welfare: direct date-weighted stream sums for worked, exercise and delayed cases; naive beliefs, sophisticated continuation, threshold ties, beta=1 and heterogeneous welfare
Randomization: closed-form hypergeometric oracle, 70 assignments, p=1/7 and positive p=1/14; 639 exact size cutoffs spanning every binary null population; six-person retention p=1/10

Synthetic truth: independent bit masks and Neyman variance identity give mean 1/2 and variance 1/16; all 256 missing-counterfactual schedules give [-1/8,7/8]; four attrition completions give [1/4,3/4]
Separation tests: remove oracle, substitute compatible zero effects, permute labels and change an actual outcome; observed inference uses observed information only
Executable: quiet import, reproducible preserved JSON, default input from unrelated working directory, unchanged input hash, and 17 direct plus CLI invalid-input rejections
Multiplicity: exact 0.2262190625 family rejection probability, three individual versus one Bonferroni rejection; historical ratio arithmetic only
Structure: three original worked cases, eight matched full solutions, answered retention, prerequisite route, four existing flat downloads and five scoped primary-source records
prose_and_proof_audit: Fixed reference, linear money utility, affordability, quality/information and transaction assumptions precede the WTP/WTA formulas; loss aversion distinguished from diminishing sensitivity and risk aversion.
Exponential time consistency proved by the common positive continuation factor under fixed information and feasibility; strict beta-delta reversal derived with boundary ties.
Fully naive beliefs beta-hat=1 kept separate from actual beta; sophisticated behavior obtained from the later choice, with no commitment, hard commitment, reminder and beta=1 branches.
Fee is a real resource-using service; date-0, undiscounted and date-1 criteria kept separate, with heterogeneity and no all-self Pareto claim.

Uniform fixed-size assignment, measurement time, potential outcomes and no-interference assumptions explicit; inclusive sharp-null test proved by finite ranking with ties rather than a continuous approximation.

Null enumeration holds observed outcomes fixed; supplied synthetic oracle instead changes outcomes with reassignment. Same observed data permit distinct effects. Logical compatibility and missing-outcome bounds are not mislabeled as confidence intervals.

Assignment versus sampling, attrition, compliance, post-treatment selection, demand/measurement, multiplicity, preregistration and external validity discussed without implying randomization identifies a latent psychological mechanism.
All eight original problems solved independently; proof/transfer/critique and concrete evaluation criteria included. Teach-back and delayed questions have answer targets.
Historical replication statement is limited to the author-deposited 2016 abstract sample and criterion; no data reanalysis, full-methods review or universal replication-rate extrapolation claimed.

resolved_authoring_issues.issue: Root requested readable spacing instead of joined numeric tokens in exercises and answers.
resolved_authoring_issues.resolution: Expanded parameters to explicit equalities and inserted ordinary prose spacing throughout exercises, solutions, delayed answers and README; preserved quantities.

limitations: Numerical checks verify these original finite models and experiment; they do not establish prevalence, a real psychological mechanism, transportability or welfare of an actual intervention.
The experiment program requires the specified complete lottery and complete binary outcomes. Sharp-null inference is not a heterogeneous-average-effect confidence procedure.
Synthetic oracle outcomes are known only by construction. Logical missing-counterfactual bounds are not confidence intervals.
Source inspections are scoped in the source proposals; the replication paper is cited from its actual author-deposited abstract and metadata, without reanalysis or a full methods audit.
Analytic proofs and open-ended exercise evaluation also require editorial reading; a checker cannot certify all prose. Root retains acceptance, integrated verification and publication.
Visual/mobile/print UI QA and external expert validation were not performed.
acceptance: Complete authored package submitted in review; root owns dependency-order acceptance, shared source integration, build and publication.
